title: domain: define ClarityError taxonomy
description: Implement the core ClarityError enum using thiserror in src/domain/error.rs. This enum will unify all domain-level errors for storage, analysis, and planning.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide a single error taxonomy for all domain logic.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return a Result containing a ClarityError variant.

unwanted.condition: IF a domain error is converted to a string
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT lose the underlying semantic cause
unwanted.because: scientific rigor requires precise error diagnostics.

preconditions: thiserror crate is available in Cargo.toml
postconditions: ClarityError enum is defined with variants for Storage, Analysis, and Planning
Display and Error traits are implemented via thiserror
invariants: All error variants MUST be serializable
No panics during error construction or formatting

questions: Which existing errors should be ported first?

phase_0: Read existing error implementations in intent/ and lattice/
phase_2: Implement From conversions for external errors (Io, Serde)
